RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Unknown; a defensible number cannot be inferred from these facts.

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex bias. Your qualifications are substantial, but an announcement does not reveal the successful candidate’s full experience or interview performance. Leadership and regulatory expertise may have mattered alongside technical qualifications.

Follow up now on your unanswered request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, and how your application was assessed against them. Two weeks’ silence warrants a reminder, not an inference of discrimination.

Raise concerns about sex if concrete evidence emerges, such as sex-based comments or inconsistent application of criteria. If you’re considering a formal challenge, check local complaint deadlines promptly.
